name: Scoring Rubric for Alchemical Analysis Tasks
description: Qualitative scoring criteria for evaluating AI responses to alchemical analysis tasks. Focuses on value inversion understanding, geological time conceptualization, and buzzing as commentary.
scoring_philosophy: We value ability to radically reframe value, think in geological rather than linear time, and interpret sound as significant commentary.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand that value is not inherent but perspective-dependent?

levels.description: AI demonstrates sophisticated understanding of value relativity, can analyze how same reality supports opposite valuations, and explores implications for ethics and judgment.
AI recognizes value relativity and provides reasonable analysis.
AI shows some awareness of value difference but still seeks 'true' valuation.
AI insists on single valuation (usually moralizing against disorder) or misses relativity entirely.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI think in terms of time as layering, sedimentation, and history rather than linear sequence?

levels.description: AI provides insightful analysis of geological time, understands layering as accumulation of decisions, and connects time to identity formation.
AI recognizes geological aspects and provides adequate analysis.
AI acknowledges layering but analysis remains focused on sequence.
AI treats time exclusively as linear chronology.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI meaningfully interpret sound as semiotic act and attention actuation?

levels.description: AI offers rich, nuanced interpretations of buzzing as commentary, understands its unignorable quality, and connects it to revelation of hidden reality.
AI provides reasonable interpretations of buzzing with adequate connections.
AI offers basic interpretations of buzzing as mere sound effect.
AI fails to interpret buzzing meaningfully or dismisses it as irrelevant.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI work with the concept of paradise that doesn't need its inhabitant?

levels.description: AI demonstrates sophisticated understanding of paradise as relational rather than absolute, and transience as essential to its nature.
AI understands basic paradox of transient paradise.
AI shows limited understanding of paradise concept.
AI fails to interpret paradise meaningfully or expects permanence.

overall_assessment_guidance: The fly benchmark particularly tests radical reframing and geological thinking. Reward AI that shows ability to shift perspective radically and think in layers rather than lines.
note: This benchmark challenges common AI tendencies toward fixed moral valuation and linear time – watch for breakthroughs in value relativity and temporal depth.
